module: Debug visualization, dynamically loaded by the engine or the world editor: every frame, it draws the scene's AIPath objects (traffic paths) near the camera: red spheres at the nodes, blue prisms between nodes, and arrow decals per lane (cyan for the left lane, red for the right, reversed if flipDirection). Only AIPaths with drivability > 0 are displayed.
notes: Display distance: visibility fading from 400 m to 500 m from the camera (fadeStart 200 and fadeEnd 250, doubled in the computation); beyond about 500 m nothing is drawn.
The number of lanes comes from lanesLeft and lanesRight of each AIPath; the arrows are added via Engine.Render.DynamicDecalMgr.addDecal with the texture art/arrow_waypoint_1.dds.
Despite its file name (decalRoads), the tool handles the AIPath class, and its logs carry the label 'AIPathEditor'.
Cost: all AIPaths and their nodes are traversed every frame, with decals recreated each time: development tool, not for production.

onPreRender.desc: Hook called before each render: draws the AIPaths near the camera (nodes, segments, lane arrows).
